svg.title: Pulse approximations of sin x
svg.desc: Three panels approximating sin x on 0 to 2π with 4, 12 and 48 flat-topped pulses at midpoint heights. The maximum errors shown below are 0.707, 0.259, 0.065.
svg.text: A skyline of pulses approaches a curve
Half-open midpoint pulses; sin(2π) = 0 matches the final-edge output. Lipschitz bound π/K; K + 1 hidden units.
